player_prompt.intro:
Maraba ki Lights Out! Yin a ka {size}x{size} tiɛm ke dɛɛ ke loo.
Yin ca paal ka yɔɔl loo dɛɛ a kɔl (ke dɛɛ ke '.')
Ka yɔɔ ka loo, ee kɔlɔ kɔlɛɛnɛɛn (ka ciɛl/ka pɛɛl/ka cuɛɛl/ka pɛɛɛl).
Tɛktɛk [row col] ka yɔɔ ka loo (0-kaŋ, kɔɔ kaŋ kaŋ ka {max_index}).
Yin a ka paal ka {max_turns} kɔɔ kaŋ ka yɔɔ ke loo.
Kɔɔ ke loo: 'O' = loo ka yɔɔ, '.' = loo ka kɔl

board.current_state:
Ciɛ̈l de ŋuaan thok (Kɛ̈ɛ̈r {moves_made}, {moves_left} kɛ̈ɛ̈r bɛ̈i, {completion}% bɛ̈i):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛn duɔ̱ɔ̱r ba yiath piny kɛ ta̱a̱dɛ [row col] gua̱th in bi̱ ri̱w kɛnɛ thärkäl ɛ la intejeri̱ tin te kam 0 kɛnɛ {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔɔrdinat a kïn wëër a kɛɛt 0 ku {max_index}. Yïn kɛɛt [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Cää tɛth lɔaac! Ci̱ riɛk riali̱kä rɛy {moves_used} jälni̱kɛ.
